status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 33% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 33 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Syrian authorities detained a former regime officer and an ex-general for the 2014 Ghouta ambush, and also captured an Al-Assad-era commander linked to the Al-Otaiba ambush, while security forces seized a drug dealer in eastern Deir Ezzor. Five Iran-linked militiamen were killed in Syria and Saudi and Syrian foreign ministers met to discuss regional security cooperation. A feminist activist warned the UN Security Council about escalating campaigns against women and restrictions on free expression, and a UN vote on the Golan reaffirmed that occupation does not confer legitimacy. EgyptAir will resume direct flights to Damascus and Aleppo in December, and the conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske myndigheter har arrestert en tidligere regimoffiser og en eks-general for Ghouta-overfallet i 2014, og også tatt en kommandør fra Al-Assad-æraen knyttet til Al-Otaiba-overfallet, mens sikkerhetsstyrker beslagla en narkotikahandler i Øst-Deir Ezzor. Fem Iran-tilknyttede militsmedlemmer ble drept i Syria, og Saudi‑ og syriske utenriksministre møttes for å diskutere regionalt sikkerhetssamarbeid. En feministisk aktivist advarte FNs sikkerhetsråd om eskalerende kampanjer mot kvinner og begrensninger på ytringsfrihet, og en FN-avstemning om Golanhøydene bekreftet at okkupasjon ikke gir legitimitet. EgyptAir vil gjenoppta direktefly til Damaskus og Aleppo i desember, og konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
